**Issues are public. Please do NOT post personal data here** (no invite links, locations, photos, email addresses or order numbers). Describe your question in general terms and we will follow up.

EventCrew has no accounts, and every event is permanently deleted when it ends. To delete your part of an event right away, tap Leave. Details: https://eventcrew.sites.tab.bot/delete/
